description: Earlier this week, Meta agreed to pay $18 billion and make sweeping changes to how minors access its social networks to settle a lawsuit brought by 29 states. But the eye-popping settlement figure wasn't what caught the attention of the Equity podcast team. Instead, it was what Meta did next. The social media giant sent an open letter to TikTok and YouTube asking the companies to join it in setting industry-wide standards for teens, including daily time limits, blocking access to apps at night,…
classificationReason: A substantial portion covers robotics investment, capability gaps, robotaxi safety data, and autonomous trucking, though the episode is a broader tech-news roundup.
qualityReason: Focused reporting and analysis across several robotics-related headlines, but not a dedicated robotics episode.
